thinking:
畅行旅行 (Changxing Travel) - Online travel booking service for trips within China.
Adults planning holidays or weekend trips.

        *   Home page (search for destinations, dates).
        *   Results page (hotels, prices).
        *   Hotel detail page.
        *   Booking page.

        *   Multiple files.
        *   Relative links, same tab.
        *   Internal CSS/JS (no remote imports).
        *   Simplified Chinese only.
        *   Realistic content (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Static (forms don't submit).
        *   Responsive (centered on 1440px).
        *   No AI mentions.

    *   `index.html` (Home/Search)
    *   `results.html` (Hotel listings)
    *   `hotel-detail.html` (Specific hotel info)
    *   `booking.html` (Checkout/Payment simulation)

    *   *Color Palette:* Deep blue and gold/orange (standard travel industry professional look).
    *   *Typography:* System fonts (Sans-serif).
    *   *Layout:* Header (Logo, Nav), Hero section, Main content area, Footer.

    *   **`index.html` (Home)**
        *   Hero: Search bar (Destination, Check-in, Check-out, Guests).
        *   Featured Destinations: Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Xi'an.
        *   Why choose us: Best price guarantee, 24/7 support.

    *   **`results.html` (Results)**
        *   Filter sidebar: Price range, Star rating, Area.
        *   Listings:
            *   Beijing Peninsula Hotel (Luxury)
            *   Peking Hotel (Historic)
            *   Courtyard by Marriott (Modern)
        *   Each card: Image placeholder (via CSS colors/shapes), price, rating, "View Details" button.

    *   **`hotel-detail.html` (Hotel Detail)**
        *   Gallery placeholder.
        *   Detailed description of a specific hotel (e.g., Beijing Peninsula).
        *   Amenities: Wi-Fi, Pool, Breakfast.
        *   Room options: Standard, Deluxe, Suite.
        *   "Book Now" button.

    *   **`booking.html` (Booking)**
        *   Booking summary (Hotel, Dates, Price).
        *   Guest information form (Name, Email, Phone).
        *   Payment method selection.
        *   "Confirm Booking" button.

    *   *Header:* 畅行旅行 (Logo) | 首页 | 目的地 | 我的订单 | 帮助中心.
    *   *Footer:* Copyright, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service.
    *   *Realistic Content:* Mention specific Chinese cities and hotel features (e.g., "近故宫", "含双早").
